name: bugfix_chapter_icons
description: Logic bug fix: chapter icons are swapped. Exchanges the mip payloads of Ch-DarkA-128 (Black Templars Maltese cross) and Ch-blackTemp-128 (Dark Angels winged sword) so the two selection-box brushes referenced by filename show the correct icon. Equal-length, zero-offset edit; file sizes are unchanged.
source: Clean Steam baseline, Build 1837603 (only swaps pixels inside the two assets; no external assets introduced).
grading: L0: equal length, changed bytes fully within the pixel regions, and post-swap readback matching the other asset's pixels; L1: ue4prop table structure unchanged and umodel can re-export. L2/L3 in-game not verified. Confirmed via visual check and reference-graph recomputation.
install_note: Overwrite the game file at the matching relative_path (back up the original first). To roll back, verify the original against the manifest's src_sha256 and restore it.
